user.title: Add a Pylontech serial bridge
user.description: Pick the ESPHome serial port wired to your Pylontech console. Host, API port and encryption key are taken from the ESPHome device. Choose manual entry if it isn't listed.

data_description.create_dashboard: Adds a Pylontech dashboard to the sidebar with the battery card, energy, balance and history. You can edit or delete it afterwards.

manual.title: Connect to the Pylontech serial bridge
manual.description: Enter the ESPHome device running the serial_proxy bridge. The encryption key is the API `key` from your ESPHome secrets.

data_description.create_dashboard: Adds a Pylontech dashboard to the sidebar with the battery card, energy, balance and history. You can edit or delete it afterwards.
data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESP (e.g. 192.168.1.50)
data_description.proxy_name: The `name:` of the serial_proxy in the ESPHome config

data_description.create_dashboard: Adds a Pylontech dashboard to the sidebar with the battery card, energy, balance and history. You can edit or delete it afterwards.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect, or the serial port name was not found on that device.

abort.not_esphome_serial: This serial port is not an ESPHome serial bridge.

data_description.create_dashboard: Builds (or rebuilds) the Pylontech dashboard in the sidebar. Rebuilding replaces any edits you made to it.
data_description.cell_sensors: Adds a voltage sensor for every cell, plus a weakest-cell and balancing sensor per battery. Sends one extra 'bat N' command per battery each poll.
data_description.sync_time: Sets the battery's real-time clock to Home Assistant's time on every connect. Only affects future log timestamps.

get_log.name: Get log
get_log.description: Reads recent records from the battery's on-device event or history log.

source.name: Source
source.description: Which log to read: 'event' (faults/state changes) or 'history' (periodic samples).

count.name: Count
count.description: How many recent records to return (1-50).

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to query (only needed if more than one is configured).

set_time.name: Set battery clock
set_time.description: Sets the battery's real-time clock. Only affects future log timestamps.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Time to set. Defaults to Home Assistant's current time.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to set (only needed if more than one is configured).

wake.name: Wake battery
wake.description: Sends the 1200-baud wake frame some batteries need to respond after a full power-off, then switches back to 115200.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to wake (only needed if more than one is configured).

start_balance.name: Start force balance
start_balance.description: Starts a force-balance session: once the stack reaches 98 % it times a two-hour hold at full charge and reports the cell spread before and after on the Force balance sensor. Set your inverter to charge to 100 % and hold.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to balance (only needed if more than one is configured).

stop_balance.name: Stop force balance
stop_balance.description: Abandons the force-balance session and resets the Force balance sensor to idle.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack (only needed if more than one is configured).
